headline.text: L3 ML4 dark filling pipe found dropping *directly into hopper* — bypassed magnet for 3+ hours before shift caught it.

summary: One food-safety control bypassed, one sanitation re-clean for allergen residue, one quality hold for underweight product. L3 ML4 filling pipe was misaligned and skipped the magnet; L1 Tunnel 2 re-cleaned for almond residue post-startup; L3 scrapped underweight bars when centerline settings weren't followed.

holds.title: Molds on hold pending full wash after allergen clean
holds.summary: L2 ML3 molds pulled during allergen changeover placed on hold; mold washer will be deep-cleaned after these molds complete their cycle.
holds.status: Open — molds being washed, washer deep-clean to follow.

holds.title: Underweight bars scrapped — centerline not followed
holds.summary: L3 ML4 depositor 4 suction stroke set to 20 instead of centerline spec of 24; boxes came up underweight, product scrapped and settings corrected to 24.
holds.status: Resolved — suction stroke adjusted to 24, weights back in range.

food_safety.title: Dark filling pipe bypassing magnet
food_safety.summary: L3 ML4 pipe for dark filling found moved and pointing directly into hopper instead of dropping through magnet; maintenance wired it back into correct position.
food_safety.status: Resolved — pipe repositioned and wired to drop through magnet.

food_safety.title: Depositor 4 nozzle plate bolts loose
food_safety.summary: L3 ML4 depositor 4 nozzle plate found with only 3 of its bolts tight; maintenance tightened all bolts during downtime for capture test.
food_safety.status: Resolved — all bolts tightened by maintenance.

food_safety.title: Damaged belt on gondola outfeed
food_safety.summary: L3 ML4 gondola outfeed belt found damaged; line held until repair to prevent belt material entering product zone.
food_safety.status: Resolved on shift — belt addressed before restart.

food_safety.title: Multiple dirty molds flagged on ML1
food_safety.summary: L3 ML1 had 4 mold alarms across third shift for dirty molds/pins; molds pulled and washed, broken pieces found in tote given to QA.
food_safety.status: Ongoing — molds cycled through washer, one lean 59 swapped out.

quality.title: S3 out-of-spec weights and piece count
quality.summary: L1 Sollich 3 performing low final weights, out-of-spec, and 37 pieces per pouch instead of target; operator and lead notified over 30 minutes prior with no improvement.
quality.status: Open at window close — improvements requested, status unclear.

quality.title: ML4 capture tests out of range
quality.summary: L3 ML4 depositor 4 capture test out of range when centerline settings applied; adjustments made, re-tested until in range before production resumed.
quality.status: Resolved — capture tests passed after adjustments.

sanitation.title: Tunnel 2 re-cleaned for almond residue
sanitation.summary: L1 Sollich 2 Tunnel 2 found with almond peels on belt during post-startup inspection; tunnel taken offline and re-cleaned before non-almond product run.
sanitation.status: Resolved — tunnel re-cleaned and passed inspection.

sanitation.title: Sollich 3 level 4 cleaning visual inspection failed
sanitation.summary: L1 Sollich 3 area failed visual inspection during level 4 cleaning; QA flagged residue in one zone, cleaning team re-worked.

sanitation.title: Sorting machine swab tests inconclusive
sanitation.summary: L2 Panning/Sorting swab tests came back inconclusive; QA requested sorting machine be cleaned before loading product.
sanitation.status: Open — cleaning requested before product load.

allergen.title: Almond peels found on Tunnel 2 belt
allergen.summary: L1 Sollich 2 Tunnel 2 had almond peels on top of band during post-startup walk; tunnel re-cleaned to prevent cross-contact on non-almond product.
allergen.status: Resolved — tunnel re-cleaned and cleared for production.

allergen.title: ML3 allergen changeover cleaning completed
allergen.summary: L2 ML3 completed allergen changeover cleaning; temper flush passed, ATP passed on buffer tank, demolding station, Sweco, and belts; molds pulled and held.
allergen.status: Resolved — cleaning complete, ATP passed, line ready.

opportunities.text: Consider adding tunnel belt inspection to Sollich 2 allergen changeover checklist — today's almond residue on Tunnel 2 required a full re-clean.
Consider adding filling-pipe position check to ML4 startup checklist — today's misaligned pipe bypassed the magnet for hours before discovery.
Review depositor nozzle-plate bolt torque checks for ML4 — today only 3 bolts were tight, suggesting a recurring maintenance gap.
